/*
name: Update Catalog

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/20 * * * *' # Executa a cada 10 minutos
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-catalog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Call update-catalog endpoint
      run: |
        curl -X POST "https://lol-giftapi.rj.r.appspot.com/update-catalog" \
             -H "x-api-key: key_for_update_catalog"
